message.content: {"name": "pinger", "summary": "Answer a ping with a pong, then finish.", "states": [{"id": "idle", "kind": "atomic", "parent": "", "purpose": "Wait for a ping."}, {"id": "done", "kind": "final", "parent": "", "purpose": "Finished."}], "events": [{"name": "ping", "direction": "input", "description": "A ping."}, {"name": "pong", "direction": "output", "description": "The answer."}], "transitions": [{"source": "idle", "event": "ping", "target": "done", "description": "Answer and finish."}]}

{"scxml": "<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="pinger" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="ping" event:schema="pinger.json#/$defs/ping" target="nowhere">
      <send target="#_parent" event="pong"/>
    </transition>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>", "schemas": {"$defs": {"ping": {"type": "object"}}}, "script": "", "tests": [{"name": "a ping is answered", "events": [{"name": "ping", "data": "{}", "delay_ms": 0}], "settle_ms": 1000, "expect_events": ["pong"], "expect_done": true}]}
